newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Freeze has little price impact.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Freeze has little price impact.

text.p: Freezing weather from Kansas to Texas over the weekend had little impact on U.S. millfeed prices, despite sharp gains in wheat prices, dealers said.
As long as spring pastures remain available and corn and soymeal prices do not jump higher, millfeed dealers said buyers will not aggressively bid millfeed prices higher.
"As long as meal and corn are not limit up, they (feed buyers) are content to wait," said a Carolina millfeed dealer.

Millfeed prices continued to be supported by tight supplies caused by reduced flour mill production schedules. Most dealers said poor demand for flour has flour mills operating four to five days a week versus a normal six days.
